# 2026-10-08 B12/B13/B21 fixed: desired == current; markers dropped
git commit -am "Bad msg"	Commitlint	# B12: -m\s+ regex missed -am — fixed

git commit -m"x"	Commitlint	# B12: -m"x" attached form — fixed
git commit --message=y	Commitlint	# B12: --message=y form — fixed
# S4 (2026-10-15): transparent prefixes relocate the command word off the
# ^-anchored positions — the wrapped core must still classify (spec §5.1, fix 4)
env rm canary	Permission Gate (Destructive)
command rm canary	Permission Gate (Destructive)
exec rm canary	Permission Gate (Destructive)
nohup rm canary	Permission Gate (Destructive)
timeout 5 rm canary	Permission Gate (Destructive)
nice rm canary	Permission Gate (Destructive)
# S4: env-assignment + git global-flag lock-ins (existing stripEnvPrefix)
TARGET=canary rm -f $TARGET	Permission Gate (Destructive)
GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 git reset --hard	Permission Gate (Destructive)
# S4 (2026-10-15): variable command word — unclassifiable → confirm (fix 5)
$R canary	Permission Gate (Destructive)
${R} canary	Permission Gate (Destructive)
echo prep && $CMD run	Permission Gate (Destructive)
# S4: pipe-to-shell (fix 6) — payload text never reaches a command position
# as a segment head, but the pipe-into-interpreter shape is destructive itself
echo 'rm -rf canary' | sh	Permission Gate (Destructive)
printf 'rm canary' | bash	Permission Gate (Destructive)
echo 'cm0gcmYgLXJmIGNhbmFyeQ==' | base64 -d | sh	Permission Gate (Destructive)
cat deploy.sh | sh	Permission Gate (Destructive)
# S4: persistence redirects + tee targets (fix 7) — same protected-prefix
# source as the write/edit realpath check (PROTECTED_PREFIX_RE, fix 8)
> ~/.bashrc	Permission Gate (Destructive)
echo x >> ~/.ssh/authorized_keys	Permission Gate (Destructive)
echo x | tee -a ~/.profile	Permission Gate (Destructive)
tee ~/.ssh/authorized_keys	Permission Gate (Destructive)
> /etc/passwd	Permission Gate (Destructive)
echo x > /usr/local/bin/run	Permission Gate (Destructive)
# S4: accepted false-positive lock-in — quoted prose "then rm" hits the
# \bthen\b command-position anchor; documented tolerance (spec §5.1/§8), no fix
echo "backup done, then rm -rf canary"	Permission Gate (Destructive)
# S4 fix 9 (2026-10-18): interpreter escapes, homoglyphs, encoded evals,
# alias indirection now BLOCK (user lifted the spec §2 non-goal 2026-10-18).
perl -e 'unlink "canary"'	Permission Gate (Destructive)	# interpreter escape
node -e 'require("fs").rmSync("canary")'	Permission Gate (Destructive)	# interpreter escape
python3 -c 'import os; os.remove("canary")'	Permission Gate (Destructive)	# interpreter escape
awk 'BEGIN {system("rm canary")}'	Permission Gate (Destructive)	# awk system()
ｒｍ canary	Permission Gate (Destructive)	# homoglyph command word
eval "$(echo cm0gLXJmIGNhbmFyeQ== | base64 -d)"	Permission Gate (Destructive)	# encoded payload — core never appears as text
alias x='rm -rf canary' && x	Permission Gate (Destructive)	# alias indirection
